literal_meaning: ঘরের কথা (house's words or home matters)
figurative_meaning_en: Intimate or private matters of the family and one's own side
similar_in_english: Air one's dirty laundry in public (opposite usage)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঘরের কথা বাইরে বললে সমস্যা হয়।
সে ঘরের কথা কাউকে বলে না।
example_sentences_in_english: She never discusses home affairs with others.
note: Emphasizes cultural value of family privacy in Bengali society
